verdict.rationale: Sift's docs describe Workflows as a 'rules automation platform' that lets users create custom rules connected to real-time Decisions/actions (ban account, cancel order) triggered by events (sift-docs-6, sift-docs-7, sift-docs-12), and the Events/Decisions APIs are confirmed live via probe (sift-probe-rt-1). However, Sift's own CEO explicitly stated in community commentary that 'we do not have any rules in our product' because rules are easy to circumvent, directly contradicting the rules-automation framing (sift-comm-8, sift-comm-9). This creates a genuine conflict between current product docs and a first-party statement about the company's approach. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that Workflows rule-building actually functions as advertised, and clarity on whether the no-rules stance was superseded by the later Workflows feature.
